text: Rocket engineers have a polite phrase for an explosion: "rapid unscheduled disassembly". A rocket is a controlled explosion pointed one way. If anything goes wrong, a valve, a pump, one weld, it stops being controlled. In 2023, SpaceX's first full Starship flight blew apart over the Gulf of Mexico. The launch had already blasted the pad so hard that chunks of concrete flew across the site. SpaceX called it a success. They got the data they wanted. The data includes Dave.
